meta.author: TnmSpiroct
meta.description:
[[]#93E2EE]Exoprosopa[[]] adds a new planet, Frostnova, into the game.
  Frostnova is a deceptively frozen planet. A volatile and hazardous tundra hides a dormant faction, Astral.
  It has a fully playable campaign with 19 campaign and 10 optional maps. 
  
  Polished content & linear campaign progression.
  Contains over 320 pieces of unique content, including blocks, liquids, items, units and specialized guardian.
  Pure modded without reuse any vanilla content.
  
  [accent[]]If you find any issues or want to gives suggestions
  feel free to join the Exoprosopa Discord server.
  Check it on my profile. My username is TnmSpiroctsub[[]].
  
  [[]#93E2EE]Exoprosopa[[]] is available in the following languages:
  - English
  - Indonesian
  - Russian
  - Simplified Chinese

Enjoy!
